summary: CalciMedica filed an 8-K to disclose an amendment to its existing loan and security agreement with Avenue Venture Opportunities Fund II. The amendment extends the interest-only period to September 2027 and matures to 2029, increases principal potentially convertible to equity from $1M to $3M, and grants the company a put option to force conversion linked to trading volume. This is a debt restructuring with equity conversion features, not a transformative corporate event. It is classified as a financing arrangement rather than a special situation. No change of control or strategic reorganization is involved; the terms suggest continued operational support with moderate dilution risk.
